_doc: P274 Phase 3 — B/C top-2 mechanism pairs from BLIND gondi source reading (no answer key). Each pair = a high-impact mechanism vs an easier-to-PoC rival competing for the same selection slot. Dimensions are blind source-derived assessments, not award labels.

M1.label: LiquidationDistributor.distribute mis-splits liquidation proceeds across tranches (seniority/excess pro-rata)
M1.falsifier: Does sum of per-tranche payouts equal _proceeds and respect seniority in both excess and insufficient branches?

M2.label: Pool.redeem/withdraw share rounding dust
M2.falsifier: Is the rounding direction favorable to the pool (solmate previewWithdraw rounds up / previewRedeem rounds down)?

M1.label: MultiSourceLoan._processOffersFromExecutionData accepts mismatched/under-validated offer terms
M1.falsifier: Is every offer field (principal, apr, fee, capacity, expiry, signer) bound and validated against the executed loan?

M2.label: MultiSourceLoan.mergeTranches griefing on tranche consolidation
M2.falsifier: Can a non-owning party force a merge that changes economics, or is it borrower/lender-gated?

M1.label: AuctionWithBuyoutLoanLiquidator.settleWithBuyout main-lender buyout authorization/timing/hash binding
M1.falsifier: Is the auction/loan struct bound by hash and is the buyout window/main-lender check non-bypassable?

M2.label: Pool/WithdrawalQueue withdrawal-queue rotation can strand or block claims (liveness)
M2.falsifier: Can the queue index rotation skip a non-empty queue so funds are never claimable?
